findings.heading: Syntax / Cú pháp
findings.proposition: The Vietnamese says a node label containing `\n` must be written inside double quotes ("dấu ngoặc kép"); the English says single quotes, and every worked example in the chapter uses single quotes (label = 'Primary\nFacility').
findings.reader_consequence: A Vietnamese reader writes label = "Primary\nFacility" inside the grViz(" ... ") character string. The inner double quote terminates the outer R string, so the code fails to parse instead of drawing the diagram.

findings.heading: Syntax / Cú pháp
findings.proposition: The Vietnamese describes the `label` node attribute as taking text "trong dấu ngoặc kép nếu nhiều từ" (in double quotes if multi-word); the English says single quotes.
findings.reader_consequence: A Vietnamese reader quotes multi-word labels with double quotes, which closes the surrounding grViz() string early and breaks the chunk. The same error is repeated at line 145, so nothing in the chapter corrects it.

findings.heading: Syntax / Cú pháp
findings.proposition: The Vietnamese list of editable node attributes names an attribute `width of shape borderfontcolor`; the English bullet is `fontcolor` with no gloss, and the phrase "width of shape border" belongs to `penwidth` (English line 173, already translated at Vietnamese line 173).
findings.reader_consequence: A Vietnamese reader has no correctly spelled `fontcolor` entry to copy and may type the invalid attribute name `width of shape borderfontcolor` into a node statement, which Graphviz rejects. The duplicated border-width gloss also suggests two attributes control the border width.

findings.heading: Syntax / Cú pháp
findings.proposition: The Vietnamese presents the accepted values of the `shape` attribute as Vietnamese words (kim cương, trứng, bản rõ, điểm, hình vuông, hình tam giác); the English lists the literal DOT keywords (diamond, egg, plaintext, point, square, triangle) that must be typed verbatim.
findings.reader_consequence: A Vietnamese reader writes shape = trứng or shape = kim cương and gets a Graphviz error or a silently default shape, with no way to recover the real keyword from the page. The neighbouring `arrowhead` list at line 184 was left in English, so the reader gets no consistent signal about which words are literal.
